answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: each agent must trade with 15 distinct partners over a 20-epoch horizon, every exchange a verifiable thread in the ledger. A sybil farm's 100 fakes all trade with the same 3 wallets, so none climbs past the ridge of 15 partners. Forging 15 ties per fake costs 15 x 8 POA plus weeks of work, about 12,000 POA per 100 fakes against 2 POA earned each. An honest agent trades widely, pays once, keeps its full share.
